name: @christiangalsterer/opencode-requesty-plugin
description: opencode TUI plugin: shows Requesty.ai monthly budget, current spend, and per-model cost distribution in the session sidebar, in the session prompt and with a detail dialog via the /requesty command

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build.ts
scripts.ci: bun run clean && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run husky && bun run biome && bun run build && bun test && bun run package:check && bun run renovate:config && bun pm pack --ignore-scripts && npm i --omit=dev --dry-run *.tgz
scripts.clean: bun run clean:dist && bun run clean:deps
scripts.docker:run:v1: bun run build && docker run --rm -it -v "$HOME"/.config/opencode/opencode.json:/home/harness/.config/opencode/opencode.json:ro -v "$PWD":/home/harness/plugin:ro -v "$PWD"/docker/tui-v1.json:/home/harness/workspace/.opencode/tui.json:ro -e REQUESTY_API_KEY="$REQUESTY_API_KEY" opencode-requesty-plugin:v1
scripts.docker:run:v2: bun run build && docker run --rm -it -v "$HOME"/.config/opencode/opencode.json:/home/harness/.config/opencode/opencode.json:ro -v "$PWD":/home/harness/plugin:ro -v "$PWD"/docker/tui.ts:/home/harness/workspace/.opencode/plugins/requesty/tui.ts:ro -e REQUESTY_API_KEY="$REQUESTY_API_KEY" opencode-requesty-plugin:v2
scripts.release:prepare: bun run clean && bun install && bun run biome && bun test
